summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, furnishing its proxy statement for the 2026 Annual General Meeting on September 8, 2026. The agenda includes director designation, compensation approvals, a reverse share split between 1-for-5 and 1-for-1,000, an authorized share capital increase to one billion ordinary shares, and a private placement of shares and pre-funded warrants to note sellers of Evofem Biosciences. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review is announced; the filing is a routine meeting circular, so the appropriate category is None.
